experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Uses a shared preprocessing module across conditions; CPU-only feature comparison.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether TF-IDF weighting improves nearest-neighbour retrieval precision over raw term counts.
experiment_plans.design: Comparative benchmark: identical retrieval procedure, two weighting schemes.

data_requirements.description: A labelled text corpus where documents sharing a label count as relevant to each other.

evaluation.success_criteria: TF-IDF improves precision at 5 by at least 0.05 over raw counts.

implementation_steps.description: Run retrieval for every query document

risks: A corpus with very few labels makes every document trivially relevant.

shared_infrastructure: A tokenization and document-term-matrix module used by both conditions in H112

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
